query:
UPDATE products SET 
  name = 'Fairytale Crush Box',
  slug = 'fairytale-crush-box',
  basePrice = 50.00,
  description = 'A sweet and thoughtful Valentine''s surprise — perfect for a smaller gift that still feels complete and special.

**Includes:**
- ✨ One Mini Cake (in an individual cake tin)
- 🍫 One 5-oz Brownie with ganache
- 🍓 Three Chocolate-Covered Strawberries
- 🍪 Two Valentine''s Oreo Pucks
- 🍪 Two Chocolate Chip Cookies
- 🍬 One Mini Bag of Freeze-Dried Candy

*Limited quantities available • Pre-designed box • No substitutions*'
WHERE name = 'Sweet Beginnings' AND productType = 'tier';

UPDATE products SET 
  name = 'Fairytale Sweetheart Box',
  slug = 'fairytale-sweetheart-box',
  basePrice = 75.00,
  description = 'A beautifully balanced box — perfect for gifting, sharing, or celebrating Valentine''s Day without going all-out.

**Includes:**
- ✨ Two Mini Cakes (in individual cake tins)
- 🍫 Two 5-oz Brownies with ganache
- 🍓 Six Chocolate-Covered Strawberries
- 🍪 Two Valentine''s Oreo Pucks
- 🍪 Four Chocolate Chip Cookies
- 🍬 One Small Bag of Freeze-Dried Candy

*Limited quantities available • Pre-designed box • No substitutions*'
WHERE name = 'Love Story' AND productType = 'tier';

UPDATE products SET 
  name = 'Fairytale Romance Box',
  slug = 'fairytale-romance-box',
  basePrice = 100.00,
  description = 'Our most indulgent Valentine''s box — designed for sharing, celebrating, and making a big statement.

**Includes:**
- ✨ Three Mini Cakes (Chocolate, Strawberry, or Vanilla Funfetti)
- 🍫 Two 5-oz Brownies with chocolate ganache
- 🍓 Six Chocolate-Covered Strawberries (three milk chocolate & three white chocolate)
- 🍪 Four Valentine''s Oreo Pucks
- 🍪 Six Chocolate Chip Cookies
- 🍬 One Large Bag of Freeze-Dried Candy

*Limited quantities available • Pre-designed box • No substitutions*'
WHERE name = 'Fairytale Romance' AND productType = 'tier';
